parsed.use_case: A reservoir or tank layout planner can compare pairs of vertical boundaries to estimate the largest rectangular cross-section that can be filled without spilling. The same calculation can help choose two support walls for a temporary liquid-holding setup when the space between them determines capacity.
system_examples: Reservoir and tank planning software — estimates the maximum contained cross-sectional area between candidate wall heights.
Teaching and interview platforms — uses an idealized container model to assess array reasoning; direct production use of this exact formulation is uncommon.
parsed.explanation: The two-pointer greedy scan runs in O(n) time and O(1) extra space, compared with checking all pairs in O(n²). It matters when many candidate boundaries need evaluation, though the exact problem is primarily a teaching exercise rather than a common production workload.
